model: REIT AFFO capitalisation at cost of equity (engine route)

inputs.sbc_source: Q2-2026 earnings release AFFO reconciliation (8-K 2026-07-29, ex99.1): non-cash stock-based compensation $8.7M H1-2026, $16.2M FY2025, annualised $17.5M; equity-award tax withholding $7.2M FY2025 / $2.3M H1-2026 (kpis), ~$3M/yr assumed. AFFO ADDS SBC BACK, so it is deducted again here.
inputs.share_count_basis: 1,101,074,906 common shares outstanding at 2026-06-30 (Q2-26 release share roll: +24.3M Golden Entertainment consideration, +7.75M forward settlement). Restricted-stock dilution 0.04M. No unsettled forward sale agreements remain (10-Q: no ATM activity H1-2026; 'remaining' 7.75M settled 2026-04-29). Third-party VICI OP units are NCI and are already excluded from AFFO attributable to common, so they are excluded from the share count too. Held flat: SBC is charged in the flows, and external growth is assumed zero-NPV (see notes), so no equity-funded issuance is modelled.
inputs.debt_memo_note: Memo only, NOT deducted: $17,218.4M total debt and $288.1M cash at 2026-06-30 (Q2-26 release debt table). AFFO is after interest expense, so subtracting net debt again would deduct it twice. net_debt/total_debt/cash are held at zero for the engine. In Aug-2026 VICI issued $900M 5.400% 2031 and $850M 5.750% 2036 notes (8-K 2026-08-06/14) to refinance the $1.75bn of 4.25%/4.50% 2026 notes - a ~$20M/yr AFFO headwind from FY2027 that the base growth path absorbs.
inputs.affo_history_source: Q4 earnings releases (8-K ex99.1) 2023-02, 2024-02, 2026-02; FY2024/FY2025 totals are the releases' rounded $2.4bn/$2.5bn refined by per-share x diluted shares; FY2026E is the 2026-07-29 updated guidance $2,675-2,695M / $2.45-2.47 per share.
inputs.dividend_memo: Quarterly dividend raised to $0.46 from $0.45 on 2026-09-03 ($1.84 annualised): ~75% of guided AFFO/share, so ~$0.62/share (~$680M/yr) is retained and reinvested.
inputs.wacc_rationale: The discount rate is the COST OF EQUITY, because AFFO is a post-interest, levered flow. USD build: 10-year UST ~5.1% (5.17% on 2026-09-25, up ~50bp in a month), plus a 4.4pp equity premium for a BBB-/BBB- rated net-lease REIT with two tenants (Caesars ~38%, MGM ~32% of rent) carrying most of the book = 9.5% base. Bull 8.5% assumes long rates ease ~75bp; bear 11.0% assumes rates stay high and the Caesars credit overhang persists. For reference, the market price implies an AFFO yield of ~10.9% on FY2026E, i.e. a cost of equity of ~13% at 2% growth - well above any of the three scenarios.
inputs.lease_treatment: VICI is the lessor. Its leases are sales-type / financing receivables; AFFO strips the non-cash effective-interest adjustments ($524M FY2025) and recognises contractual cash rent only. Triple-net: tenants fund maintenance capex (AFFO capex deduction <$1M/yr), so capex_pct and da_pct are zero.
inputs.nci_treatment: AFFO attributable to common stockholders is used; third-party OP units and the 20% Harrah's Joliet LandCo minority are already deducted in it.
inputs.notes: MODEL: REIT AFFO capitalisation at cost of equity, run through the component engine with the AFFO stream as 'revenue', a 100% 'EBITDA margin', zero D&A/capex/tax/working capital, SBC charged at 0.76% of AFFO, and net debt held at zero. Routing: dcf-methods SKILL.md routes REITs to AFFO capitalisation at CoE; VICI is a triple-net gaming/experiential landlord (no IAS-40 style revaluation, but GAAP net income is dominated by CECL allowance swings - Q2-26 net income fell 39% on a $271M CECL charge while AFFO rose 7.8% - so P/E and reported OCF/FCF are not usable). First valuation of this ticker; no memory entry. GROWTH DISCIPLINE: retained AFFO (~25%) funds acquisitions, so valuing the full AFFO stream AND capitalising acquisition-driven growth would count the reinvestment twice. The paths therefore carry only (i) the in-place portfolio's contractual escalators (~2.2% on ~$3.7bn of cash rent = ~3.0% of AFFO), (ii) run-rate of already-closed deals (Golden Entertainment $87M/yr from 2026-04-30, Gamehost C$16.1M from 2026-06-24), less (iii) refinancing drag as ~4.6% average-coupon debt rolls into ~5.5-6% markets (~0.6-0.7% of AFFO per year). External acquisitions are treated as zero-NPV in base and bear; the bull case gives them a small positive spread. FY0 is the FY2026 guidance midpoint ($2,685M) because the valuation date is three quarters through FY2026; Y1 is FY2027.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: FY2026E AFFO/share guidance midpoint ($2.46) vs FY2025 actual ($2.38). Historical CAGRs are acquisition-driven (MGM Growth Properties, $17.2bn, closed Apr-2022; Venetian Feb-2022) and are not a forward proxy.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 3yr CAGR 8.2% vs revenue 15.5% and EPS 27.2% diverge by >30%. All three are distorted: revenue/equity by the 2022 MGP and Venetian deals (equity-funded), EPS by CECL allowance swings (FY2022 EPS $1.27 depressed by a CECL charge). The fcf_* fields here are AFFO per share; reported FCF is not computable (capex not tagged after FY2019, and REIT OCF includes non-cash lease adjustments). AFFO/share 3yr CAGR 7.2% includes the MGP accretion; the forward organic rate is ~2.3%.
historical_growth.notes: Revenue: FY2022 $2,600.7M -> FY2025 $4,006.1M (3yr); FY2020 $1,225.6M -> FY2025 (5yr). Equity: $22,290M -> $28,223M (3yr); $9,494M -> $28,223M (5yr). EPS: $1.27 -> $2.61 (3yr); $1.76 -> $2.61 (5yr). AFFO/share: $1.93 -> $2.38 (3yr); FY2020 AFFO/share not retrieved, so the 5yr AFFO CAGR is left null. SBC is small (~0.7% of AFFO) and stable, so the SBC-adjusted and reported AFFO CAGRs are the same to one decimal.

base.growth_rates_rationale: FY2027 +2.7%: organic escalators (+~$80M) plus the full-year run-rate of Golden Entertainment and Gamehost (+~$35M), less the 2026-note refinancing (-~$20M) and modest further rate drag. Years 2-10 ~2.0-2.4%: escalators net of ~0.6pp/yr refinancing drag on the 2027-2030 maturity ladder ($1.5bn/$2.0bn/$1.75bn/$2.0bn), easing as the book reprices. No acquisition growth (zero-NPV).
base.terminal_cap_multiple_rationale: 14x AFFO: VICI's own 5-year P/AFFO range was ~12-16x; Gordon at 9.5%/2.0% is ~13.6x, so Gordon binds.

bull.growth_rates_rationale: CPI runs above the 2% floors on the Caesars and CPI-linked leases, refinancing drag is smaller as long rates ease, and acquisitions (8-9% initial yields in 2025) earn a positive spread over the cost of capital worth ~0.5pp/yr.

bear.growth_rates_rationale: Caesars Regional Master Lease + Joliet ($730.9M/yr net of the Joliet NCI) is restructured in FY2027 with a ~30% (~$220M) rent cut - the Q2-26 CECL charge already reflects a tenant whose new senior secured debt rated below VICI's prior estimate. That takes FY2027 AFFO ~-5.5% after escalators and deal run-rate; thereafter growth slows to ~1.5-1.8% on a lower rent base and heavier refinancing drag.
bear.wacc_rationale: 11.0%: 10-year UST stays >5% and the equity premium widens ~1pp on tenant credit stress.

scenario_narratives.base: Contractual cash rent compounds at ~2.2% with ~100% occupancy, all tenants paying. Rate headwinds absorb ~0.6pp/yr of AFFO growth as the 2027-2030 ladder refinances at ~5.5-6%. External growth continues but creates no value above the cost of equity. Cost of equity 9.5% against a ~5.1% 10-year Treasury.
scenario_narratives.bull: Long rates retreat ~75bp, CPI stays above the escalator floors, and VICI keeps placing capital at 8-9% yields with a positive spread - including the Club Med, Lucky Strike and loan-book partnerships broadening the tenant base. AFFO/share grows ~3%/yr and the market re-rates toward 16x AFFO.
scenario_narratives.bear: Caesars, the ~38%-of-rent tenant now issuing lower-rated secured debt, forces a rent reset on the regional master lease (the Las Vegas lease and the MGM/Venetian leases are untouched). Rent is cut ~30% (~$220M/yr), AFFO falls ~5.5% in FY2027, the dividend is held flat, and the stock settles on a 12x AFFO multiple with a 11% cost of equity as rates stay ~5%.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Symmetric 25/50/25 rather than the 15/50/35 house default: the bear case is a concrete, named credit event (Caesars regional rent reset) that the Q2-26 CECL charge and the 2026-09-25 JPMorgan downgrade both point to, and 10-year Treasuries at ~5.1% leave little room for the multiple expansion the bull needs. Concentration (two tenants ~70% of rent) argues against tilting toward the bull.

valuation_philosophy.summary: VICI is valued as a stream of levered, post-interest cash rent: AFFO attributable to common, less the stock compensation AFFO adds back, capitalised at the cost of equity with growth limited to what the existing leases contract for, net of refinancing drag. Net debt is never subtracted, because AFFO is already after interest. Acquisitions are assumed to earn their cost of capital (zero-NPV) except in the bull case, because the AFFO being capitalised is the same money that funds them. On these terms the shares price in a ~13% cost of equity or a substantial Caesars rent cut; the valuation question is mostly about tenant credit, not growth.
key_risks_to_valuation: Tenant concentration: Caesars ~38% and MGM ~32% of rent. A Caesars Regional Master Lease restructuring is the single largest swing factor (~$730M/yr of rent).
Interest rates: 10-year UST ~5.1% (up ~50bp in September 2026); $7.25bn of notes mature 2027-2030 at ~4.6% average coupons and refinance ~1pp higher.
CECL allowance ($1.93bn at 2026-06-30) is non-cash, but a rising long-term PD for a major tenant is an early sign of real rent risk.
Loan book growth (mezzanine/preferred equity, One Beverly Hills) adds credit exposure: one $80.7M golf-resort loan is on non-accrual and one $90M loan was modified in H1-2026.
Regional gaming exposure to consumer weakness and to iGaming/prediction-market cannibalisation of land-based casino EBITDAR, which drives rent coverage.

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 22.54-33.01 (at the 52-week low after a ~10% September slide on rates and a JPMorgan downgrade).
data_sources.financials: SEC EDGAR: Q2-2026 10-Q (filed 2026-07-29) and earnings release ex99.1 (AFFO reconciliation, debt table, share roll, FY2026 guidance); Q4 FY2025/FY2023/FY2021 earnings releases for AFFO history and guidance; 8-Ks 2026-08-06 and 2026-08-14 (notes offering). Revenue/equity/EPS history from VICI_Metrics.csv (XBRL).
data_sources.qualitative: VICI_Analysis.json was not present at build time. Market context from Yahoo Finance news (2026-09-25 to 2026-10-03): dividend raised to $0.46 on 2026-09-03; JPMorgan downgrade and Baird target cut to $28 on 2026-09-25; 10-year Treasury 5.17% on 2026-09-25; Century Mile/Downs lease agreements 2026-09-29.
